Privacy

Enquiries sent from this site

When you send a quote, callback, survey-visit request or a message, the details you enter (contact details, move details, contact preferences) are sent to CODEM and stored in a database hosted by the provider Supabase. They are used only to answer your request and prepare your move. Photos or videos attached to the quote are stored in a private space with the same provider, accessible only to CODEM. No advertising trackers are used. Anonymous, cookie-free audience measurement (page views, clicks on action buttons, quote steps) is stored with the same provider, without IP addresses or any data that identifies you; it is turned off if you choose “Reject all”.

Your rights

You can ask to access, correct or delete your details by contacting CODEM on +33 1 71 36 18 38 or by post at 39 boulevard de Strasbourg, 94130 Nogent-sur-Marne.

Your preferences

Your privacy-dialog choice is saved locally in your browser. You can change it using the footer privacy link or clear it in your browser settings.
